title: Director of Admissions
description:
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Brazil. No visa support will be provided.

*Please attach your CV in English.


Primary Purpose of the Position

The Director of Admissions serves as the strategic and operational leader of Graded’s admissions department. The Director is responsible for overseeing the department to ensure the school’s mission, values, and culture are warmly and effectively communicated to prospective families. The Director oversees all aspects of recruitment, admissions, enrollment, and retention, ensuring that Graded attracts and enrolls a diverse, mission-appropriate student body.


Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive admissions and enrollment strategy aligned with Graded’s mission, vision, and long-term goals.
  • Regularly review admissions policies and procedures to ensure equity, transparency, and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to set enrollment targets and manage class size.
  • Monitor demographic trends, market drivers, and competitor data to adapt strategies and maintain Graded’s competitive edge.
  • Build and maintain relationships with embassies, corporations, relocation agencies, feeder schools, and community partners.


Admissions and Enrollment

  • Direct the end-to-end admissions process, from initial inquiry and outreach through to committee decisions, enrollment, and long-term retention.
  • Integrate data analytics to inform enrollment strategies and market positioning, with a particular focus on attracting and enrolling international candidates.
  • Lead and coordinate open houses, tours, and orientation events to authentically engage prospective families and welcome them into the school community.
  • Oversee a transparent and timely communication strategy throughout the admissions journey, ensuring a supportive experience by providing clarity on status and requirements.
  • Coordinate admissions assessments, WIDA screening, and interviews in close partnership with academic leaders to ensure mission-appropriate student placement.
  • Partner with the Registrar and Business Office to manage the enrollment and annual re-enrollment processes, ensuring efficiency for both new and current families.


Community Engagement

  • Serve as one of the key ambassadors of Graded, articulating the school’s value and unique offerings to prospective families and the wider public.
  • Work closely with the Office of Institutional Advancement and Communications to ensure consistent brand messaging in all admissions materials and events.
  • Engage faculty, staff, parents, alumni, and volunteers in supporting recruitment and retention efforts.
  • Maintain strong relationships with current families and develop initiatives that strengthen community ties.


Management and Operations

  • Lead, mentor, and evaluate the Admissions team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Build and manage the department’s annual budget and ensure effective use of resources.
  • Collect, analyze, and report admissions and enrollment data to inform strategic decisions and provide updates to school leadership and the Board.
  • Serve as a member of school-wide committees and attend leadership meetings as required.


Certifications and Education

  • Bachelors degree in Business/Administração , Marketing, Communications/Comunicação Social , Public Relations/Relações Públicas or related field.


Desired

  • Masters degree (MBA or pós-graduação ) in Educational Leadership, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Professional training or certification in enrollment management or admissions leadership.


Experience

  • 3–5 years of admissions or enrollment management experience in bilingual/international educational institutions.

Desired

  • Experience with data-driven enrollment management and use of admissions platforms (e.g., PowerSchool, Blackbaud, etc).


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Native or near-native English and Portuguese fluency.
  • Strong communication skills, including written, presentation, and public speaking.
  • Proficiency in technology, particularly Google Suite.
  • Ability to manage complex projects and competing priorities with great attention to detail.


Desired

  • Knowledge of admissions and enrollment software systems (PowerSchool preferred).
  • Familiarity with international education markets and trends.

title: Tentative: High School English Teacher
description:
This position is designated as a Local Hire . Applicants must hold Brazilian citizenship or already possess the legal right to work in Brazil. This role will not be advertised through international recruitment agencies or platforms.



Primary Purpose of the Position

The High School English Teacher delivers rigorous, engaging instruction in literature, language, and composition that develops students’ analytical thinking, written and oral communication skills, and appreciation for diverse voices and perspectives. The teacher fosters intellectual curiosity, critical inquiry, and independent thought while preparing students for advanced coursework and post-secondary success. In alignment with the school’s mission and values, the English Teacher cultivates reflective, responsible global citizens through the study of language and literature.

Important: This is a tentative position for the 2026–2027 school year and is contingent upon enrollment and program needs.


Principle Duties and Responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver high-quality English instruction across grade levels (e.g., Grades 9–12), including literature, composition, and language study.
  • Design purposeful, differentiated, and intellectually challenging lessons that foster critical reading, analytical writing, and effective communication.
  • Guide students in the study of diverse literary genres, historical contexts, and global perspectives.
  • Develop students’ research, argumentation, and presentation skills.
  • Support students in advanced coursework (e.g., IB, AP, or honors) as assigned.
  • Encourage student autonomy, reflection, and ownership of learning.


Assessment and Feedback

  • Design and administer diagnostic, formative, and summative assessments aligned with course standards.
  • Provide timely and constructive feedback that promotes growth and academic excellence.
  • Maintain accurate records of student performance and communicate progress clearly to students and families.
  • Prepare students for internal and external assessments as applicable (e.g., IB, AP, standardized exams).


Learning Environment

  • Create a classroom environment that is safe, inclusive, intellectually stimulating, and student-centered.
  • Foster respectful dialogue, purposeful discussion, and collaborative learning.
  • Hold students accountable for high academic standards and integrity.
  • Collaboration and Professional Practice
  • Collaborate with colleagues to ensure vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment within the English department.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary projects and school-wide initiatives.
  • Participate actively in professional development, faculty meetings, and school committees.
  • Communicate effectively with students, parents, and colleagues in culturally appropriate ways.
  • Demonstrate professionalism in attendance, punctuality, and conduct.


Certifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Literature, English Education, or a related field.
  • Valid teaching certification/license (U.S. or internationally recognized equivalent).

Desired:

  • Master’s degree in English, Literature, Education, or related discipline.
  • Certification or training in IB, AP, or advanced English coursework.


Experience

  • Minimum of five years of high school English teaching experience.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching literature and composition at a rigorous academic level.


Desired

  • Experience teaching IB, AP, or honors-level courses.
  • Experience in international or multicultural school settings.
  • Experience mentoring students in research, extended writing, or academic competitions.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Deep knowledge of literary analysis, composition pedagogy, and language instruction.
  • Strong ability to teach critical thinking, analytical writing, and research skills.
  • Effective classroom management in discussion-based environments.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.


Desired

  • Familiarity with international curricula (e.g., IB, AP, Common Core).
  • Ability to integrate technology to enhance reading, writing, and research instruction.
  • Knowledge of strategies to support multilingual learners and diverse student needs.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

As a Data Engineer in Riot Data Foundations on the Data Experiences and Automation team, you will have the chance to affect how Riot collects and uses data to improve the experience for players and Rioters. You'll work closely with our technical lead to expand data consumption and reporting capabilities and build solutions to improve the development lifecycle for data engineers and insight analysts throughout the organization. You'll be helping as Riot enables advancements and fast iteration in Machine Learning and GenAI pipelines. You will bring your experience working with globally distributed systems and work with our team of software engineers to help build efficient solutions. You will report into the Engineering Manager of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable pipelines for data supporting insight into the Data Foundation ecosystem.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. title: Economist, Latin America
description:
Summary of Primary Role


The Economist will play a vital role in supporting our sales pipelines, driving client engagement, and producing data-driven insights that impact on our target markets.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support sales pipelines through data-driven insight production and client meetings in Latin America, both in the Colombia and Brazil offices.
  • Attend client meetings alongside our sales teams for strategic opportunities.
  • Produce regular data-driven economic insights and dashboards aligned with CEIC’s go-to-market plan target addressable markets.
  • Support global insight production through team collaboration and global editorial calendar with thematic cross-region and global economic insights.
  • Support the delivery of the regional community engagement plan.
  • Contribute to marketing activities related to the development of the company’s brand awareness and thought leadership in Latin America countries through preparation of content and participation marketing and public speaking initiatives.


To be considered for this role you will need to have:


  • A degree in Economics or Finance.
  • Prior experience with macroeconomic, industry and financial data, with a focus on Latin America.
  • Excellent analytical capabilities working with large data sets with rigorous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in front of a large audience.
  • Experience writing research publications.
  • Ability to work well in a team, showing excellent team spirit; strong organizational skills are essential.
  • Experience in programming languages applied to economics (R, Python, etc)
  • Fluency in English. Experience writing English-language analytical publications.
  • Spanish speaking is a plus.
  • Positive attitude and a “can do” approach.


What We Offer:

  • Full time employment contract
  • Open and friendly working atmosphere
  • Excellent remuneration package
  • Flexible working culture and hybrid working model


How to Apply:

If you are looking for interesting and challenging job, please, do not hesitate to apply and send your CV in English.

All job applicants will be treated with strict confidentiality. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.


About ISI Markets:


ISI Markets is the most comprehensive source of trusted data and actionable insight on emerging and developed markets. We provide the intelligence and insights to act with confidence in the world’s highest potential and fastest growing markets. ISI Markets is comprised of four brands (CEIC, EPFR, EMIS and REDD) that share a common purpose to illuminate the opportunity in emerging and developed markets where information can be hard to obtain and even harder to rely upon. We leverage deep local knowledge, well established networks and leading-edge software and advanced analytics to deliver intelligence that informs our clients’ investment, strategic and risk decisions.

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - APS3 TECNOLOGIA - Estruturação completa da área de Recursos Humanos da APS3
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Desde 2012 a APS3 atua como agente SIEMENS, auxiliando as empresas a trilharem seu caminho rumo à digitalização e atuando nos mais diversos tipos de indústria. Especialista em MOM (Manufacturing Operations Management) e em PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), a APS3 cobre as áreas de venda, consultoria, implantação e suporte do Opcenter APS / Preactor, do Opcenter X e do Teamcenter PLM, soluções líderes de mercado na transformação digital / digitalização. A APS3 ouve seus desafios e objetivos de negócios e, em seguida, colabora com você para desenvolver uma solução de tecnologia adaptada ao seu negócio e sua indústria. Como tem experiência em ajudar muitas empresas de vários segmentos industriais, a APS3 trabalhará com você para garantir um sucesso semelhante para sua empresa.

O objetivo desse projeto é implantar um sistema robusto de gestão de pessoas que contemple trilhas de carreira, avaliação contínua de desempenho, Programas de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) e iniciativas estruturadas de engajamento e clima organizacional, assegurando o crescimento sustentável da empresa e a satisfação dos colaboradores.

Projeto: Estruturação completa da área de Recursos Humanos da APS3.


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo em Psicologia, Administração ou Recursos humanos.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnóstico e Estruturação de Cargos e Carreiras.
  • Implementação do Sistema de Avaliação de Desempenho.
  • Criação e Gestão de Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).
  • Desenvolvimento de Políticas de Engajamento e Clima Organizacional.
  • Capacitação e Desenvolvimento de Lideranças.
  • Consolidação e Documentação dos Processos de RH.
  • Avaliação Final e Planejamento Estratégico de RH.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:

  • Conhecimento intermediário dos principais aplicativos office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint).
  • Experiência profissional ou acadêmica com avaliação de desempenho, plano de desenvolvimento pessoal e com estruturação de plano de carreira.


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Já ter trabalhado em empresa na área de RH.
  • Conhecimento em testes comportamentais como DISC ou similares.
  • Já ter atuado em empresas de tecnologia.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Superbac - Otimização dos processos industriais e planta fabril  | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Superbac é referência em soluções biotecnológicas sustentáveis, com atuação nos setores de agronegócio, saneamento, meio ambiente e indústria. Reconhecida por seu compromisso com a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos de base biológica, a empresa se destaca pelo uso de tecnologia de ponta e por contribuir ativamente com práticas sustentáveis no Brasil e no mundo.

Se você tem perfil analítico, gosta de desafios científicos aplicados à realidade e quer atuar em uma empresa de biotecnologia em expansão, essa vaga é para você!


ormação Acadêmica:

Graduação em Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Doutorado em áreas compatíveis com atuação em desenvolvimento e otimização de processos biotecnológicos.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Otimização dos processos industriais e planta fabril para a produção de microrganismos e metabólitos, visando o aumento da produtividade e a redução de custos operacionais.


Principais Atividades:

  • Análise dos equipamentos e sistemas periféricos instalados;
  • Coleta e análise de dados de produção de diferentes microrganismos;
  • Modelagem dos processos de cultivo;
  • Otimização de sistemas e definição de novas estratégias, parâmetros e variáveis de processo;
  • Atuação técnica com foco em produtividade e viabilidade econômica.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e otimização de processos em biorreatores de bancada ;
  • Foco em produtividade e viabilidade econômica.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência com biorreator piloto, especialmente para multiplicação de bactérias;
  • Conhecimento em escalonamento de microrganismos e dimensionamento de biorreatores.

Formato de trabalho : Presencial



Soft Skills: Trabalho em equipe; Pensamento crítico; Criatividade; Organização; Ética e responsabilidade.

Através das nossas duas marcas, Copagaz e Liquigás, respondemos por 25% da distribuição de Gás Liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP) do Brasil. Possuímos operações em 25 estados e Distrito Federal e cerca de 90 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos. Sendo a maior empresa no segmento de GLP da América Latina. Somos uma empresa privada, que está presente em milhares de lares desde os anos 50. Além disso, fazemos parte do seleto grupo de investidas ItauSA.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Parcerias e Aplicações para fazer parte do nosso time!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sua missão é liderar a estratégia técnica de acesso a novos mercados, apoiando os Key Accounts na estruturação de propostas complexas que garantam a melhor escolha energética para o cliente (técnica, econômica e ambiental) e maximizem a rentabilidade da companhia. Os especialistas também terão papel fundamental na formação do time de consultores KA.


  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos estruturados da matriz energética dos clientes, avaliando performance atual, eficiência térmica e oportunidades de substituição de combustíveis;

  • Analisar demanda térmica, perfil operacional, localização e metas de sustentabilidade para determinar a solução energética mais adequada, considerando limites técnicos, logísticos e regulatórios;
  • Elaborar comparativos técnicos entre moléculas (GLP, GNL e Biometano), garantindo aderência aos critérios de engenharia e mitigando riscos de subdimensionamento;
  • Construir e validar estudos de viabilidade econômica, incluindo Payback, VPL, Simulações de Capex/Opex e cenários operacionais;
  • Converter ganhos de eficiência energética e redução de emissões em argumentos financeiros claros, suportando estrategicamente o processo de tomada de decisão do KA e do cliente;
  • Garantir consistência técnica nos modelos utilizados, mantendo base de dados, premissas e metodologias alinhadas às diretrizes da área;
  • Realizar a homologação técnica de fabricantes de caldeiras, queimadores e empresas de engenharia térmica, assegurando conformidade com as soluções da companhia;
  • Capacitar parceiros quanto às especificações técnicas dos produtos e aplicações, reforçando critérios de dimensionamento, segurança e performance;
  • Atuar como ponto técnico de referência para parceiros, contribuindo para a geração qualificada de oportunidades com aderência técnica.

description:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a gerência regional de vendas e com a unidade de negócios, para implementar as estratégias desenvolvidas para a região de atuação.


Quem você é:

Você identifica oportunidades que beneficiam o cliente. Você assume novos desafios prontamente, sem planejamento desnecessário. Você se mantém atualizado sobre as políticas, práticas e tendências atuais e possíveis futuras na organização, na concorrência e no mercado. Você ouve os outros com atenção. Você aceita atribuições que ampliam suas capacidades.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção, Elétrica ou Controle e Automação;
  • Demonstrar experiência, relacionamento sólido e histórico comprovado de sucesso com grandes empresas da região, atuação na prospecção de novos clientes e projetos greenfield, especialmente no segmento de mineração;
  • Capacidade de navegação e negociação em contas complexas, em diversos níveis hierárquicos;
  • Conhecimento sólido de soluções tecnológicas aplicadas à indústria de Mineração;
  • Forte habilidade em gestão de relacionamento e negociação com clientes de grande porte;
  • Experiência mínima de cinco (5) anos na área de Confiabilidade (Gestão de Ativos/Sistemas de Monitoramento de Máquinas e soluções correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado e desejável espanhol;
  • Local de Trabalho: Canaã dos Carajás, Parauapebas e região;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (~75% do tempo).

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Encarregado de Serviços Gerais
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Encarregado de Serviços Gerais, responsável por coordenar e executar atividades de manutenção predial, conservação de ruas e cuidados com jardins e áreas externas.


Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Acompanhar e executar serviços de manutenção predial preventiva e corretiva
  • Coordenar atividades de limpeza, conservação e organização das áreas externas
  • Garantir a conservação de ruas internas, calçadas e jardins
  • Orientar e acompanhar a equipe nas atividades diárias
  • Zelar pelo uso correto de ferramentas e equipamentos


Quais os requisitos?

  • Experiência com manutenção predial e conservação de áreas externas
  • Noções de jardinagem e pequenos reparos (hidráulica, alvenaria e pintura)
  • Experiência com liderança de equipe será um diferencial
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e responsável


Localidades:

Residir em Tanabi, Monte Aprazível, Palestina e Nova Granada.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: General Consulting Client Manager
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, empowering businesses everywhere to compete and thrive in the modern data-driven economy. We always put the Customer First.


Our mission: to enable businesses to grow and reimagine themselves by becoming advocates and champions for their Customers. With deep heritage and expertise in retail – one of the world’s most competitive markets, with a deluge of multi-dimensional data – dunnhumby today enables businesses all over the world, across industries, to be Customer First.


dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro.


We’re looking for a General Consulting Client Manager who expects more from their career. It’s a chance to become a trusted partner to key Retail Clients, building relationships to define and deliver upon their strategic needs. It’s an opportunity to bring world leading customer data to life and make a real impact in driving change and growth for our client, and in turn grow the dunnhumby business.


What we expect from you:

  • Build and own strong relationships with C‑level and senior stakeholders at the retailer.
  • Expand dunnhumby’s network across the retailer’s value chain and act as a trusted, collaborative advisor, deeply understanding the retailer’s strategy, customers, and commercial priorities.
  • Establish governance routines to ensure clear priorities, progress tracking, and two‑way feedback.
  • Identify high‑value opportunities where dunnhumby can support the retailer and shape the workplan accordingly, overseeing and driving delivery of the client workplan to ensure measurable value.
  • Spot upsell opportunities and support the full sales cycle through to contract.
  • Collaborate across the broader dunnhumby team to present a unified, integrated approach to the client.
  • Lead, coach, and performance‑manage the Retail Client team to deliver against account goals.
  • Mitigate risks, demonstrate dunnhumby’s values, and ensure team members have the required skills and training.
  • Measure value delivery regularly, including ROI analytics and client impact surveys.
  • Support contract renewal efforts and partner with the account lead to maximize renewal success.
  • Stay informed on global retail trends and share insights with client stakeholders.
  • Manage the account P&L, ensuring financial performance and value creation.
  • Fluent English Speaker.


What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One and dh Thrive as the living proof. Everyone’s invited.


Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found (here)

title: Gen AI Architect
description:
Gen AI Architect

Brazil/Argentina

In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organisation.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Senior Internationalization Engineer (Technical)
description:
Senior Internationalization Engineer

Contract: 12 months (with potential extension based on performance)

Client: A leading multinational telecommunications company (name disclosed at interview)


Overview:

As the Senior Internationalization Engineer, you will drive Client’s i18n strategy, ensuring products are built for global readiness from day one. You will shape standards, guide engineering teams, and embed scalable internationalization practices across all product lines.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the internationalization strategy across multiple product lines and platforms.
  • Define, implement, and enforce i18n best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to identify and resolve i18n issues early.
  • Conduct code reviews, architectural evaluations, and readiness assessments for global compatibility.
  • Mentor engineering, localization, and cross-functional teams on i18n concepts, tooling, and workflows.
  • Champion continuous improvement of i18n processes, tooling, automation, and global readiness frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Master’s preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in Android development.
  • Strong programming skills (Java, Kotlin, or similar).
  • Unicode/CLDR, ICU libraries, font, locale, bi-directional writing system, complex scripts, text formatting rules, resource externalization.
  • Solid problem-solving skills and ability to work across multiple teams and systems.
  • Proven expertise leading internationalization efforts across multiple products or large-scale platforms.
  • Strong technical proficiency with i18n concepts, tools, and languages (e.g., Unicode, ICU, Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar).
  • Demonstrated ability to guide, mentor, and upskill engineering and localization teams on i18n best practices.
  • Effective communicator able to clearly convey global readiness requirements across engineering, product, and UX teams.
  • Experience resolving complex i18n issues early in development through architecture reviews or code-level interventions.

title: Regulador de Sinistros Sênior Cyber
description:
Regulador(a) de Sinistros Sênior – Especialista Cyber


PROPÓSITO PRINCIPAL

Atuar na regulação end-to-end de sinistros Cyber , conduzindo o caso desde o aviso de sinistro (FNOL) até o encerramento, com foco na investigação da causa, orientação de cobertura, coordenação de especialistas, quantificação de perdas e emissão de recomendação técnica de indenização, garantindo rastreabilidade, governança e excelência técnica.


PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES

• Conduzir sinistros Cyber first-party e third-party de forma completa (end-to-end), incluindo eventos de ransomware, vazamento de dados (data breach ), interrupção de negócios e falhas tecnológicas.

• Coordenar a resposta a incidentes e a gestão de crise, mobilizando e governando especialistas forenses, jurídicos, de contabilidade forense, comunicação e provedores de resposta a vazamento.

• Analisar a causa, o vetor e a extensão do incidente, consolidando cronologia, evidências e impactos segurados.

• Interpretar e orientar a cobertura de apólices Cyber (gatilhos, exclusões, sub-limites, franquias e períodos de carência (waiting periods) ).

• Controlar, auditar e validar custos de resposta, mitigação e recuperação, assegurando aderência às regras do programa.

• Conduzir quantificação robusta de perdas, incluindo Interrupção de Negócios (Business Interruption – BI), despesas adicionais e demais danos cobertos.

• Gerenciar demandas de terceiros e a resposta a vazamento de dados, quando aplicável, mantendo governança de comunicação e de custos.

• Elaborar relatórios técnicos de regulação (preliminar e final) e emitir recomendação de indenização/ajuste final.

• Manter comunicação clara e estruturada com seguradoras, segurados e demais stakeholders, inclusive em nível executivo.

• Registrar todas as etapas do sinistro em sistemas, garantindo documentação adequada, rastreabilidade e suporte a auditoria.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS

• Atuar de forma remota/virtual (desk ) e, quando necessário, in loco , inclusive em incidentes críticos.

• Participar de revisões pós-incidente (post-incident review ) e contribuir com recomendações de mitigação e melhoria contínua.


REQUISITOS

Formação

• Ensino superior completo.

• Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas correlatas (Gestão de Riscos, Tecnologia, Segurança da Informação, Finanças, Auditoria ou Direito Empresarial) é desejável.

Experiência

• Experiência sólida em regulação/ajuste de sinistros complexos, com atuação end-to-end.

• Experiência comprovada em sinistros Cyber e de tecnologia, incluindo coordenação de especialistas.

• Vivência em Interrupção de Negócios (BI) e validação de despesas adicionais é altamente desejável.

• Experiência em ambientes de alta confidencialidade e na gestão de incidentes críticos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos

• Conhecimento prático em resposta a incidentes Cyber (ransomware, vazamento de dados, exfiltração, contenção e recuperação).

• Capacidade de interpretar apólices Cyber e estruturar posicionamento de cobertura com base técnica.

• Forte habilidade analítica para quantificação de perdas e controle de custos.

• Comunicação clara, estruturada e executiva (oral e escrita).

• Organização, rigor documental e atenção a detalhes.

• Capacidade de atuar sob pressão, liderar em cenários de crise e gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders.

• Inglês avançado/fluente é altamente desejável; espanhol é diferencial.


CERTIFICAÇÕES DESEJÁVEIS (NÃO OBRIGATÓRIAS)

• CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GREM), ISO/IEC 27001.

• Certificações em privacidade e proteção de dados (IAPP, LGPD).

• Certificações em claims, contabilidade forense, Interrupção de Negócios (BI) ou fraude (ex.: CPCU, AIC, CFE).

title: Client Solutions Director
description:

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.


The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for defining, optimizing, and sustaining safe, efficient, and repeatable module assembly and integration processes for large Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) equipment manufactured through a global supply chain model. This role ensures manufacturing operations consistently meet Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery (SQCD) objectives through structured process design, documentation, and continuous improvement.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize module assembly and mechanical integration processes, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and safety requirements.
  • Develop assembly process flow for skid/module build-up based on engineered drawings and vendor-supplied fabricated parts.
  • Review incoming fabricated components and purchased parts for Design-for-Assembly (DfA) and installation readiness in coordination with SQE.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and SQE to identify supplier-induced dimensional, tolerance, or documentation issues impacting assembly sequence.
  • Develop and maintain assembly procedures, work instructions, SOPs, and control plans.
  • Define kitting strategy and assembly staging requirements based on Kanban methodology.
  • Establish mechanical and piping fit-up methodology for vendor-supplied sub-assemblies.
  • Support incoming inspection and disposition of non-conforming vendor parts impacting assembly schedule.
  • Lead the transition from engineering to production, ensuring tooling, documentation, training, and test readiness.
  • Provide structured feedback to engineering on recurring assembly challenges to improve design standardization.
  • Support pre-FAT assembly verification activities prior to QC-led FAT execution.
  • Develop and execute testing protocols to validate equipment performance, safety, and compliance.
  • Analyze, document, and report test results in accordance with applicable standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement to enhance testing accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Industrial Engineering principles (time studies, capacity modeling, line balancing, takt analysis).
  • Conduct assembly line balancing and station-level takt optimization for modular skid build up.
  • Lead Kaizen events, value stream mapping, 5S, standardized work, and waste reduction initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analysis (A3, 5 Whys, Fishbone) and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure manufacturing processes comply with internal quality standards and external regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with SQE on supplier corrective actions affecting module assembly or FAT readiness.
  • Conduct audits and inspections of manufacturing and testing activities.
  • Support incoming inspection, non-conformance management, and corrective action processes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance).
  • Train and mentor manufacturing personnel on processes, safety, and best practices.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–8+ years in manufacturing or industrial engineering; 2–4+ years in Lean/process improvement roles.
  • Familiarity with skid/module-based process equipment (gas processing systems preferred).
  • Strong understanding of integrated process systems (e.g., gas processing, upgrading systems, controls).
  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma (Green Belt preferred), and data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI, Minitab)
  • Preferred with knowledge in standards as ASTM A516 Gr.70, ABNT NBR 6656 USI SAC 50, ABNT NR-12, NR-13, ASME VIII Div.1, ISO 2768-mK, MTC EN 10204 Type 3.1, ANSI class, AWS A2.4, ASTM A36, ABNT NBR 7007 MR250, and SSPC-SP6/SP10.
  • Experience working directly with customers and plant operators in on-site environments.
  • Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to senior leadership.
  • English proficiency required.


How to Apply:


We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.

  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Consultor de negócios
description:

A Escalar Odonto é uma empresa que conta com pessoas focadas em gerar RESULTADOS. Todo o trabalho desenvolvido para os nossos clientes é como se fosse para nosso próprio negócio. Como será o seu dia a dia:​

  • Conduzir reuniões com os colaboradores das clínicas para promover consciência, engajamento e alinhamento de Expectativas com o programa.

title: HR Plant Manager
description:
We are looking for a HR Plant Manager to join our team in our plant in Brazil (Sete Lagoas/MG) . The chosen candidate will be responsible to execute HR strategy, deal with recruitment, training, and development processes, managing local trends and needs building the best team in line with budget, guidelines and local labor laws and regulations. The role creates a diverse and inclusive ecosystem by leveraging talent management, succession planning and accurate total rewards for the assigned Plant, acting in full alignment with the leader above as well as the coherent with the organization model and HR policy and guidelines. HR Manager ensures accurate execution of cost analysis in line with guidance and leads HR administration and payroll processes being a unique point of contact for labor industrial relations and disputes at the plant level.


Activities


  • Defines, develops, and implements HR programs and plans on annual basis for the assigned sites in alignment HR Strategy defined by CHRO and in alignment with the HR Corporate directives, industrial plan, and budget.
  • Manages staff and recruiting processes, implements compensation and reward strategy, and ensures consistency with the organizational model, in full collaboration with the Regional HR, HR Center of Expertise and CHRO.
  • Analyses the country-specific trends on a regular basis, sharing with regional/corporate actionable inputs and insights and contributing to the definition of sustainable and competitive actions and strategic targets.
  • Ensures the execution of corporate global and local guidelines and procedures, implements promptly and effectively corrective and preventive actions to ensure full alignment and compliance with local law.
  • Executes performance management, training, and development program defined by HR Center of Expertise and provides them prompt and accurate feedback to ensure the effective and sustainable roll-out for the sites assigned.
  • Recruits, develops and retains resources, cultivates high potential talents, enables succession plans.
  • Plans how to cover replaces/covers vacant local positions, implements job enlargement, rotation, and enrichment in line with legal requirements, procedures, budget, business and organization model, and Company guidelines.
  • Creates an inclusive environment and adopts and open-door, encourages employees to speak up as key of success.
  • Provides guidance on HR processes, solves issues in line with legal, HR& Organization and business strategy.
  • Ensures the employee relationship management respects the relevant legal and Labour contract requirements, development, compensation, and benefit guidelines practices, in adherence with the company governances.
  • Provides the plant with HR services, including administration, payroll, and industrial relations, collaborating with the HR team and implementing tools and fair labor practices per labor law.
  • Elaborates and monitors the budget, supervising the related processes at the local level aimed at ensuring cost-effectiveness and company sustainable business growth.
  • Oversees and keeps HR costs effectiveness under control promptly identifying opportunities to exploit, managing risk appropriately, and setting up a contingency plan to foster HR strategy deployment.
  • Manages, coaches, and develops assigned staff, ensuring effective talent management and career path
  • Interacts regularly and effectively communicates and networks with key internal and external stakeholders, to deliver assigned targets as well as to ensure an effective alignment of company objectives and strategic goals.


Mandatory Qualifications


  • 5 years proven experience gained in Human Resources management and +2 years as HR Plant Manager, within international companies
  • Proficiency in English (speaking and writing in English is 40% of daily routine)
  • Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or Psychology
  • Knowledge of Talent Management and succession planning techniques
  • Knowledge of Compensation and Total Reward techniques, methodologies, tools
  • Knowledge of HR Management, employment-related laws, trade unions organising and management
  • Knowledge of human resources information systems (HRIS)
  • Change Management
  • Knowledge of Product and Production: process, features techniques
  • Data Analysis and performances metrics: methodologies, techniques, tools and applications
  • Budget management and cost control knowledge
  • Live in Sete Lagoas (work in presence is mandatory)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge in Excel and Power BI
  • Experience with WCM
  • Experience with ISO standards


About Us

We are a dynamic organization with great customers and a culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver amazing results. We are also growing and looking to hire talented and passionate individuals to join our team!

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista de Controle de Projetos
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Como Analista de Controle de Projetos você atuará como suporte integral à execução de projetos de instrumentação.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Administrar atividades operacionais relacionadas a pedidos OM e projetos PA.

  • Executar atividades em sistemas ERP (Oracle), incluindo setup de projetos, faturamento e encerramento.
  • Monitorar fluxo de caixa (cashflow) e relatórios de compromissos financeiros.
  • Garantir precisão e pontualidade no processo de faturamento.
  • Apoiar análises de dados e relatórios financeiros.
  • Suportar a criação e manutenção de cronogramas em ferramentas como MS Project
  • Acompanhar prazos de entrega e coordenar alinhamentos com stakeholders internos.
  • Monitorar progresso em relação aos marcos críticos e reportar desvios.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Document Control para assegurar cumprimento das datas de entrega de documentação.
  • Manter estruturas e informações em softwares de gestão de projetos (Clarity).
  • Realizar setup de WBS, alocação de recursos e processos de encerramento.
  • Manter repositórios de dados organizados (SharePoint, DocPro ou MS Teams).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de project controls e lições aprendidas.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e melhoria de processos e procedimentos de controles de projetos.
  • Contribuir em atividades relacionadas ao processo de S&OP quando aplicável.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar treinamentos internos conforme necessário.
  • Promover o uso das políticas corporativas da Emerson no ambiente de projetos do PMO.

Quem você é:

Você organiza suas atividades com autonomia, mantendo foco em qualidade, precisão e cumprimento de prazos. Trabalha bem com informações estruturadas, identifica riscos e sabe quando escalar temas críticos para garantir que decisões sejam tomadas no tempo certo. Comunica status, necessidades e desafios com clareza, colaborando com diferentes áreas e perfis.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em administração ou suporte a projetos, project controls ou coordenação de pedidos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos, faturamento e conceitos básicos de cronograma.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP e ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Excel avançado e capacidade analítica.
  • Conhecimento em Office 365
  • Inglês avançado ou espanhol para comunicação com times Latam
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba-SP

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Experiência com software Clarity.
  • Conhecimento em MS Project, Primavera ou ferramentas equivalentes.
  • Vivência em PMO ou empresas de engenharia/projetos.
  • Familiaridade com processos S&OP.
  • Conhecimento em Sistema Oracle.
  • Conhecimento em CRM Cloud.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Analista de Regulação Econômica
description:
Trabalhar na Rumo é fazer parte de algo grande: cada trem que parte, cada via cuidada, cada operação realizada com segurança faz diferença na vida de milhares de pessoas e empresas todos os dias. Se você gosta de desafios reais, de trabalhar com propósito e quer contribuir para um futuro mais eficiente e conectado para o Brasil, seu caminho pode começar aqui.

Vem fazer parte do movimento. #VemPraRumo


Sobre a posição

A área de assuntos regulatórios é responsável por garantir que as diferentes malhas da empresa operem em conformidade com as leis e normas estabelecidas por agências reguladoras e órgãos governamentais. Suas principais funções incluem a análise e interpretação de regulamentações, a gestão de contratos de concessão, a interação com agências regulatórias como a ANTT, e a monitoração de mudanças legais que possam impactar as operações da organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o Analista Sênior na condução de processos de revisão ordinária, sendo responsável pelo levantamento de subsídios junto às áreas internas e pela execução de cálculos preliminares.
  • Realizar simulações do valor de outorga variável e de revisões extraordinárias (FCM) sob supervisão, preparando as análises de sensibilidade e cenários de impacto.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de pleitos de reequilíbrio, sendo responsável pela coleta de dados técnicos e financeiros, preparação de análises de suporte e acompanhamento dos processos.
  • Conduzir atividades de fiscalização econômica, realizando o levantamento de subsídios com as áreas internas (CSC, seguros, financeiro) e elaborando respostas técnicas à ANTT.
  • Monitorar a tarifa praticada pela companhia para verificação do atendimento da tarifa-teto, dispersão tarifária e IPOA, identificando potenciais desvios e impactos regulatórios.
  • Acompanhar os prazos de vigência das apólices de seguro, elaborando cartas e realizando os envios à ANTT, garantindo a conformidade com as exigências regulatórias.
  • Realizar o controle dos pagamentos da concessão, atualizando planilhas de controle e conferindo as memórias de cálculo da ANTT.
  • Auxiliar na construção, atualização e manutenção dos bancos de dados e dashboards da área, garantindo a rastreabilidade e qualidade das informações.


Experiência

  • Experiência prévia em regulação econômica, finanças corporativas ou áreas correlatas.


Formação:

title: MCA IV&V Engineer
description:
Descrição do emprego

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Contagem, Minas Gerais.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of Modular Control Architecture (MCA) software team. The MCA SW architecture is highly flexible, made up of many modular software, application, and hardware elements. While flexibility adds opportunity and capability, it also adds complexity, driving the importance of a robust platform SW and communication strategy. MCA is built on MBSE (Model Based System Engineering) principles for requirements management and test cases with full traceability built into the MBSE model.


How will you make a difference?

The “MCA Controls Test Engineer” is responsible for development and maintenance of test plans and procedures to execute the testing on HITL & locomotive environments. This role includes reviewing and analysis of design requirements, functional specifications and creating test plans and test procedures.


What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation engineering with a broad technical understanding of IV&V activities.
  • Strong knowledge of related design/test engineering experience with hands on experience on testing and validation utilizing the following platforms: HITL, SITL, system level (preferable Locomotive or Automotive).
  • Experience in developing test procedures for control software, electrical and electronic equipment, systems, and components.
  • Strong understanding of general control design principles including various communication protocols (Serial RS232/422, CAN or ethernet).
  • Ability to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives.
  • Ability to travel (domestic and overseas) as required (travel < 20%).

What will your typical day look like?

  • Participate in design/system requirements review, specification reviews at various levels within the system/sub-system.
  • Development of test procedure on Magic Draw/Doors to perform system integration testing and system level testing.
  • Provide inputs for creating test environment/setup, review & maintain test results.
  • Execution of test procedures on control software and components utilizing the following platforms: Hardware in the loop (HITL), Model in the loop (MITL), Locomotive.
  • Create a record of all deviations/defects with enough details using formal software life cycle management tools (Clear Quest etc.) & provide support until resolution.
  • Develop automation scripts to automate test procedures, data collection, generate reports and ensure repeatable measurements with the help of test tools and simulators.
  • Perform system-level testing on HITL/Locomotive against the system requirement and interface specification prior to production release.
  • Working closely with the internal and external design/test teams in identifying problems & implementing solutions.
  • Produce periodic status and operational reports
  • Apply and improve the utilization of all software and hardware tools and assist in the creation of new testing software, hardware tools and techniques.
  • Make independent technical contributions in support of program objectives, as well as interacting with other Wabtec or contract engineers.

Benefícios:

Na Wabtec, pessoas estão em primeiro lugar. Por isso, cuidamos para que nossos funcionários se sintam valorizados e tenham as ferramentas necessárias para prosperar. Ao se juntar a nós, você terá acesso a uma série de benefícios pensados para promover seu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Confira o que oferecemos para que você se sinta parte de uma empresa que apoia sua jornada profissional e pessoal:

  • Assistência Médica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos)
  • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos)
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Política de Alimentação de acordo com localidade
  • Seguro de vida
  • Programa de Assistência ao Empregado: orientação psicológica, jurídica, financeira e assistência social
  • Headspace – aplicativo focado em saúde mental
  • Cartão ou Cesta de Natal aos funcionários de acordo com localidade
  • Presente de Natal para filhos de até 11 anos de idade
  • Licença maternidade estendida
  • Programa para Gestantes e Bebês
  • Política de incentivo a idiomas
  • Programas de Mentoria e acesso a plataforma de treinamento
  • Wellhub
  • Auxílio farmácia

Informações Adicionais

O que você poderia conquistar em um ambiente que realmente coloca as Pessoas em Primeiro Lugar?

Na Wabtec, não se trata apenas de um emprego — é sobre o impacto que você gera. Quando nossas pessoas se unem, Expandimos o Possível,melhorando constantemente o que fazemos e como fazemos — para nossos clientes e para uns aos outros.

Se você está pronto para revolucionar a forma como o mundo se move para as próximas gerações, a Wabtec é o lugar certo para você.

Quem somos nós?

A Wabtec é uma fornecedora global líder em equipamentos, sistemas, soluções digitais e serviços de valor agregado para os setores ferroviários de carga e transporte. Com mais de 150 anos de experiência, estamos na vanguarda em segurança, eficiência, confiabilidade, inovação e produtividade. Seja em carga, transporte, portos, logística, mineração, indústria ou setor marítimo, nossa expertise, nossas tecnologias e nossas pessoas — juntas — estão acelerando o futuro do transporte. Com raízes que remontam a George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison e Louis Faiveley, a Wabtec sempre desenvolveu tecnologias e implementou soluções para diversos setores essenciais, atendendo às necessidades de clientes e governos.

Com cerca de 30.000 colaboradores ao redor do mundo, entregamos desempenho que move o mundo adiante. Somos aprendizes contínuos, apaixonados em evoluir cada vez mais. Saiba mais em

A cultura nos impulsiona e abre possibilidades.

Acreditamos que as melhores ideias surgem da combinação de experiências e origens diversas. Na Wabtec, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam incluídos. Estamos construindo uma cultura em que a liderança, a inclusão e a sua perspectiva única impulsionam o progresso.

title: Collections Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.


About the Job

We're looking for a Collections Agent to join our Operations Team. As a Collections Agent you will be responsible for executing hands-on collections activities to ensure timely recovery of overdue payments while maintaining professional relationships with SME customers. You will work directly with active cases, contacting customers and following up on overdue payments. The role plays a key part in reducing early-stage delinquency and supporting healthy cash flow across Credix’s portfolio.


Qualifications

  • 1–2 year of experience in collections, accounts receivable, customer service, call centers, or operational roles.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • The ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with basic data (SQL), Excel, internal tools, and spreadsheets.
  • Willingness to learn and grow within the role.
  • Collaborative mindset work seamlessly with cross-functional teams.
  • Interest in fintech, operations, or financial services.


Responsibilities

  • Contact customers according to defined schedules and scripts via phone, WhatsApp, and email.
  • Develop and utilize communication scripts to negotiate.
  • Follow up on overdue payments and payment promises, ensuring timely actions aligned with the delinquency cycle (e.g., DPD+3, DPD+7).
  • Provide repayment options to improve the borrower experience.
  • Accurately log all payment information, customer interactions, agreements, and outcomes in internal systems.
